documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of 76.7 billion for financial year 2025-26, representing a 12% increase year-on-year, while net income rose 11% to 26.4 billion. The Board declared two interim dividends totaling 400 per share for the fiscal year. Management highlighted the acceleration of an AI-led innovation agenda, integration of cloud-native and agentic AI architectures, and strong execution resulting in an operating margin of 44%. Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of 68.5 billion for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, marking a 7% increase over the previous year. Net income for the fiscal year reached 23.8 billion, representing a 7% rise with a net margin of 35%, while the operating margin improved to 44%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the business landscape was shaped by dynamic global developments, evolving geo-political conditions, and accelerating technology trends.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape was shaped by dynamic global developments, evolving geo-political conditions, and accelerating technology trends, creating a market environment that rewarded resilience and innovation.
